facts.fact: Tilde 站在国王暗室里像哨兵，头发散着、两手空着
Liran 看着女儿，眼里没有一点认得她的意思
facts.anchor: there was no recognition in the sea blue of his eyes

facts.fact: Tilde 对国王说「我们不认识她」
facts.anchor: She is no one. We do not know her

facts.fact: Elise 判断这不是失智，是被驯服的服从
她看清 Tilde 已经成了篡位者，也是下毒的人
Tilde 低声说救我们的不是爱
facts.anchor: It is not love that will save us

facts.fact: Tilde 把「自由」当作给 Elise 的最后一件礼物
facts.anchor: Freedom is my last gift to you

facts.fact: 她被击晕，视野先白如天鹅羽毛，再黑如林中阴影
facts.anchor: then turned as dark as the shadows
